460258.overview:
Hot Ball (1979) is a solid-state pinball machine produced by Taito do Brasil. It is recognized as a licensed, thematic variation or "Taito version" of the 1977 Bally Eight Ball table, adapting the popular pool-themed gameplay for the Brazilian market. Because it is a rare table with no surviving original ROMs, it is often emulated using the Bally Eight Ball rules. 

Rules: 

Hit targets and rollovers to pocket 7 balls.  After each 7 balls, the 8 ball target becomes lit.

Hit the 8 ball target when lit to light the next 7 balls.

Bank shot scores lit value, increases multiplier or awards extra ball.

Complete all 15 balls once to light super bonus.  Complete all 15 balls twice to light special.

Spinner scores 10 points or 1000 points when lit.

Middle two lanes at top of playfield award bankshot 'item' (not points) if arrow pointing to it is lit.

461918.overview:
Enter the royal court of the House of Diamonds! Duel face cards, climb the ranks, and play for power in this regal pinball kingdom.

Featuring a cards and casino theme, House of Diamonds is a solid state pinball table for up to four players, released by Zaccaria in July 1978. 

It is an updated version of their earlier electro-mechanical, single player table 'Queen's Castle' (released April 1978), featuring very similar fantasy artwork and the same layout, consisting of 4 flippers, 2 bumpers, 1 kick-out hole, 10 stand-up targets, 2 slingshots, 1 roll-under spinner and a horseshoe lane.

This table was recreated by Magic Pixel and released as DLC for Zaccaria Pinball on Steam on 16 June, 2016. A modern remake was released for the same app in 2017, followed by a retro version in 2018, and a deluxe version in 2020.

461920.overview: Hustler was manufactured by LTD do Brasil, a company known for producing licensed and unique pinball machines in Brazil during the early solid-state era. The table features a pool/billiards theme, typical of the "hustler" or bar-room aesthetic popular in 1970s and 1980s pinball.

468559.overview:
A table based on the first installment of the animated film trilogy adaptation of Cressida Cowell's book series. Young Viking teenager Hiccup, after trapping the rare and dangerous Night Fury dragon, discovers the possibility of taming dragons while his people are being attacked by them.

Released as part of the Dreamworks Pinball pack for Zen Pinball Party for Apple Arcade on 3 September 2021, and subsequently released as DLC for Pinball FX on 15 December 2022.

As DreamWorks is currently owned by Universal Pictures, this table pack was produced as a continuation of Zen Studios' partnership with the firm following the Universal Pictures Classics mini-table pack.

468642.overview:
The classic, critically-acclaimed strategy game, now in pinball form! Use your skills to strategize, build up your fleet, and carry out missions. Clash in colossal space battles and command your armada to great effect as you earn jackpots and the high score!

Features:
- Play through missions inspired by the original classics
- Lock balls into the Carrier and watch it deliver them to the playfield for Multiball
- Protect the Mothership at all cost in Diamond Shoals
- Spell SALVAGE and shoot precisely to gather up enemy ships for big scores
- Dodge debris and take out auto guns in the Karos Graveyard
- Command the Hiigaran fleet with well-placed shots in the Hiigara Wizard Mode

Homeworld is one of the three tables included in the Gearbox Pinball pack, released alongside the official launch of the Pinball FX reboot.

471585.overview:
Halloween is a 1978 American independent slasher film directed and scored by John Carpenter, who co-wrote it with producer Debra Hill. It stars Donald Pleasence, Jamie Lee Curtis (in her film debut), P. J. Soles, and Nancy Loomis. The film follows escaped mental patient Michael Myers, who was committed to a mental institution for murdering his teenage sister on Halloween in the fictional Illinois town of Haddonfield; 15 years later, he returns to Haddonfield, where he stalks teenage babysitter Laurie Strode and her friends while his psychiatrist Dr. Samuel Loomis pursues him.

Halloween - Big Bloody Mike is a highly advanced, fan-made Future Pinball mod created by TerryRed, utilizing the PinEvent V2 framework and FizX physics to deliver a creepy, immersive horror experience. It features an animated, stalking Michael Myers, dynamic flashlights, blood effects, and enhanced lighting designed to act as a premium virtual pinball table. 

The original version of this Halloween table was created by SLAMT1LT for Future Pinball in 2017, and has no connection with the physical Halloween table released by Spooky Pinball in 2021.

472034.overview:
High Speed: Hot Pursuit ULTIMATE Edition is a mod of the classic 1986 Williams High Speed pinball machine for Future Pinball. It enhances the original police chase theme with modern visual effects, enhanced lighting, and modified audio.

Among the improvements is a radio allowing players to select different driving music to accompany gameplay. Tracks include "Joyride" (Roxette), "Fly Away" (Lenny Kravitz), "Tainted Love" (Marilyn Manson), "Nothing's Gonna Stop Us Now" (Starship), and even the Dukes of Hazard theme music.

An updated version was released by user Phéromones in March 2026 with improved FizX 3 physics.

472167.overview: A Halo-inspired original table for Visual Pinball X based on Bally's Attack From Mars.

472385.overview:
Hong Kong Phooey is an American Saturday morning animated television series produced by Hanna-Barbera Productions and originally broadcast on ABC. The main character, Hong Kong Phooey, is the clownishly clumsy secret identity of Penrod "Penry" Pooch, an anthropomorphic dog working at a police station as a "mild-mannered" janitor under the glare of Sergeant Flint, nicknamed "Sarge".

Penry disguises himself as Hong Kong Phooey by jumping into a filing cabinet – in so doing he always gets stuck, and is freed by his striped pet cat named Spot – and once disguised, gets equipped with the "Phooeymobile" vehicle that transforms itself into a boat, a plane or a telephone booth, depending on the circumstances.

In fighting crime, he relies on his copy of The Hong Kong Book of Kung Fu, a correspondence-course martial-arts instruction handbook. However, his successes are only either thanks to Spot, who provides a solution to the challenges, or the direct result of a comically unintended side effect of his efforts. The humor of the incompetence of Hong Kong Phooey is a recurring theme of each episode.

This table was released by Hursty in 2025 for Visual Pinball X. It is a re-skin of Stern's Wild Fyre table.

473368.overview:
A popular and original zombie-themed table for Future Pinball, first released in 2005. The table has become a Halloween staple in the virtual pinball community. It is celebrated for its accessible, family-friendly approach to the horror genre, swapping genuine gore for kid-friendly, cartoonish ghouls and lighthearted fun. 

It has received several updates to its physics by GeorgeH, most recently in 2023.

474195.overview: Heavy Metal: MTV Edition is a Future Pinball mod of Rowamet's classic 1983 table that adds rock music and a miniature TV screen showing MTV video shorts. The mod was released in 2012, partly as a tribue to Neil Armstrong, the astronaut who died the same year, as MTV had used edited stock footage of the historic Apollo 11 moon landing in their iconic 1981 opening broadcast.

474280.overview: A Future Pinball mod of Gottlieb's 1979 table, "The Incredible Hulk" featuring new audio (including Eminem's "The Monster" during gameplay), a DMD, and improved physics.
